methodology: Fixed live top 20 snapshot before changes. Every description was reviewed against the actual profile: 14 months of Java/Spring backend work, B2 English, Sevilla, EUR 24,000 minimum to change. Conditional relevance means occupational/location plausibility, including the user-authorized 2-3 year stretch. It does not prove every requirement is met or estimate an interview probability. Removed exact postings and demonstrated expert/frontend requirements count negative for an active shortlist. Unknown exact primary identity, geography or core skill fit remain outside the precision denominator. Application coverage is independent of compatibility and includes open incompatible roles. Unknown salary is never invented. No forms were completed/submitted. Fresh cached Himalayas 403 responses were not retried twenty times.

metrics.precision_scope: Conditional active-shortlist relevance among sufficiently evidenced cases; not full qualification or hiring probability.
